subject: SOC 2 / ISO 27001 artifact checklist & clarifications
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novushealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Novus Health - Security Team <security@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 12:12:00 -0500
Subject: RFP: SOC 2 + ISO 27001 evidence request (initial)

Jonas,

Thanks for taking our call today. Per the RFP, Novus Health needs a consolidated response to the attached SIG spreadsheet and a mapped artifact set for your SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 coverage. Key asks from procurement/security:

- Completed SIG spreadsheet (column-level answers) for the 2026 vendor assessment.
- SOC 2 Type II report and system description (or an attestation timeline if still in process).
- ISO 27001 scope statement and current certificate (if held) or manual evidence mappings.
- Evidence files for encryption at rest/in transit, access reviews, and change control.

Can you confirm: a) who at Redwood will own the technical evidence delivery, and b) whether you can provide an artifact index (zip preferred) by EOD Wednesday (2026-11-18)?

I've attached the Novus_RFP_SIG_Questions.xlsx for your team to populate. If anything needs alternate formatting, let me know.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Novus Health
[Attachment: Novus_RFP_SIG_Questions.xlsx]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novushealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: SOC 2 + ISO 27001 evidence request (initial)

Daniel — thanks for the clear checklist and for the call. We can take this on. High-level plan:

1) Neha (cc) will own the control mapping and artifact packaging (SIG + SOC 2 index).
2) Stephanie (security engineer) will provide the encryption and key-management artifacts.
3) I'll coordinate delivery and send an index.zip by EOD Wednesday 2026-11-18.

Couple of quick items we want to clarify before finalizing the SIG answers:
- Which SIG scope do you want completed? Full SIG V1.12 (all sections) or a narrowed scope limited to Infrastructure & Data Protection?
- For SOC 2, do you need the actual Type II report (signed) or the summary + system description + selective artifacts?

I attached our working artifact index template to accelerate handoff. If Novus needs a different structure, we can adapt.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_soc2_artifact_index_v1.xlsx]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@novushealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: SOC 2 + ISO 27001 evidence request (initial)

Hi Daniel,

Thanks — Neha here (Head of Security Operations). Quick clarifications so we provide the tightest package by Wednesday:

- SIG scope: we'll complete the full SIG spreadsheet but clearly tag responses that are "policy-only" vs "evidence-attached" so Novus can triage what needs review. Please confirm if evidence for HR background checks is in scope or handled separately by your vendor risk team.
- SOC 2 deliverables: we can provide the signed SOC 2 Type II report (if permitted to share) + system description and an indexed set of redacted evidence PDFs. If NDAs are required for the full report, please advise — otherwise we'll include the report.
- ISO 27001: Redwood does not currently hold an ISO cert; we will provide a mapping (control-to-evidence) and our ISMS policy artifacts. If Novus requires certification, we can provide our roadmap and audit firm contact.

Attachments: preliminary artifact index (partial) and an example evidence naming convention.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_system_description.pdf]
[Attachment: redwood_evidence_naming_convention.txt]

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novushealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: RFP: SOC 2 + ISO 27001 evidence request (initial)

Thanks Neha — that helps. A couple follow-ups from the Novus security team:

- HR checks: please include the policy and a sample redacted hire file demonstrating verification steps (not full PII).
- Encryption evidence: we need a KMS diagram, the key rotation policy, and a sample KM audit log (redacted).
- ISO mapping: the mapping is fine; Novus risk requires a short cover note explaining how Redwood's shared responsibility model maps to our controls (particularly for managed hosting scenarios).

Deadline: EOD Wednesday is ideal. If you hit blockers, can you commit to partial delivery (SIG + SOC 2 index) by Wednesday, and the remaining artifacts by Friday 2026-11-20?

Also, can you upload artifacts to the Drive folder linked below rather than sending zipped email attachments? Novus security will pull directly from the shared folder for scanning.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_redwood-novus-artifacts

Regards,
Daniel\Procurement — Novus Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novushealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: SOC 2 + ISO 27001 evidence request (initial)

Daniel — good plan. Confirming delivery commitments and owners: 

- Wednesday 2026-11-18 EOD: Completed SIG spreadsheet (tagged), SOC 2 index + system description (PDF), preliminary ISO mapping document uploaded to the Drive.
- Friday 2026-11-20 EOD: Remaining artifacts (HR sample, KMS diagram, rotation policy, redacted logs).

Stephanie will upload the encryption and KMS artifacts to the Drive folder. Neha will complete the SIG answers and package the SOC 2 evidence set. Laura (cc) will coordinate any contract/procurement items if you need an updated DPA or narrow-scope NDA.

I created a temporary folder and shared edit access to the address procurement@novushealth.com. If you prefer to restrict edits, Daniel tell us and we'll switch to view-only.

Thanks — we'll keep you posted on each upload.

Best,
Jonas
[Attachment: delivery_plan_timeline.txt]
